svg.desc: A Firefox window showing six tabs of the Recipes group, with the add-on popup open. The popup lists four tab groups: Default, GitHub, Recipes and Cats. The selected Recipes group shows its mouse controls: a move-tabs arrow, an edit button and a delete button; the other groups show their number of tabs. The page behind shows a stack of pancakes with butter and blueberries.

g.text: New group · Search tabs · Mouse controls · Help
Number of tabs in the group
The group's key: press it to switch to the group
Move the current tab here (Shift: all tabs)
Delete the group (Ctrl+Z brings it back)
Edit the name, container and color
Selected group: Enter switches to it
